preprocessing_decisions.mask_size_mismatch: Mask nearest-resized to the image size at evaluation time; raw files unchanged.
preprocessing_decisions.fuseg_overlap: Images within pHash Hamming <= 8 of any FUSeg2021 image are excluded.

aggregate_metrics._note: Why not accuracy: ~15% foreground → a background-only predictor gets ~85% accuracy. Dice/IoU focus on the foreground class and are appropriate for imbalanced segmentation.
